2026-09-29 03:58:32.204790 | controller |
2026-09-29 03:58:32.204794 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-09-29 03:58:32.204797 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-29 03:58:32.204800 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-09-29 03:58:32.204804 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-09-29 03:58:32.204807 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-09-29 03:58:32.204816 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
